description:
👉 Claude Code Masterclass & AI Builders Course
https://www.theaiautomators.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=tutorial&utm_content=claude-design-inspiration

🔗 Every site, tool & prompt from this video
https://www.theaiautomators.com/claude-design-inspiration-all-the-links-from-the-video/

Claude can build a beautiful website. It just doesn't know what great design is. 

Models like Fable 5.1 and Opus have been trained on millions of sites, so when you ask for something modern, what you actually get back is the average of all of them. 

That average is why so much AI built work looks the same.

The fix isn't a better adjective. Claude is not a mind reader, and words are a poor way to describe a look. Show it instead. Point it at real work you like, tell it what to take and what to avoid, and let it loop until it hits the bar.

So this video is a tour of where designers actually get their inspiration, broken into 6 categories, and how to get those references in front of Claude. 

The three landing pages at the top, the 3D brewery, the coffee roaster and the cabins, were all built exactly this way with Fable 5.1.
